query:
INSERT INTO ips (ip, first_seen, last_seen, domain_count, updated_at)
             VALUES ($1, $2, $2, 1, $2)
             ON CONFLICT(ip) DO UPDATE SET
               last_seen = GREATEST(ips.last_seen, $2),
               domain_count = ips.domain_count + CASE WHEN $3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
               updated_at = $2
